what_happened: The task description cites 'Task 371 (teach roadmap-integration.sh the stage-based layout, fix its silent abort)' as relevant and possibly blocking a clean regenerate. No task 371 exists in specs/state.json (verified: zero objects with project_number 371). The only 371 artifact is the archived, unrelated specs/archive/371_revise_bimodal_reference_bimodal_only. The roadmap-integration.sh/stage-layout incompatibility is therefore UNOWNED, not owned by a filed task.

roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate is inoperative on specs/ROADMAP.md: exit 1, zero stdout, zero stderr (verified with --dry-run, which writes nothing). Cause: assemble_roadmap (line 393) emits a fixed 8-section skeleton (## Goal, ## Gate state, ## Next, ## Open work, ## Checks..., ## Settled decisions..., ## Standing rules, ## Unfiled observations) and ROADMAP.md contains NONE of them -- it uses the Stage 0-4 layout. extract_section returns empty for all eight. Consequence for this task: there are no generated sections in this roadmap, so the whole file is authored and must be hand-edited; --regenerate must not be relied on.

745's closure artifacts answer the (C)-bound ownership question unambiguously and without inference: the probe header (hit-presented-model-a.lean:85-99), the RaySummary README (lines 264-293), docs/theorem-index.md:206 and the summary's 'The bound verdict, as recorded' all independently state the bound half as NOT DELIVERED with the single successor obligation named verbatim. Three concordant in-tree records meant no reconstruction from agent summaries was needed for the task's hardest acceptance criterion.

scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh WIRED_REPO holds two entries pointing into specs/archive/706_... and specs/archive/710_..., which .gitignore:94 excludes. git ls-files --error-unmatch confirms both files are UNTRACKED. The evidence gate therefore depends on files absent from a fresh clone. This upgrades task 720 from a citation re-point to a gate-integrity repair.

two_fwd_paths does not exist anywhere in the repo (grep -rn, zero lines). 733's mirror probe established backward non-determinism only, so the characterization of 733 as R1's sharpest available falsifier is a claim about the probes that exist, not the probe space. Recorded as coverage gap; no route switch is manufactured from it (739's no-route-switch ruling binds).

pastStab_iff_allBwdPathsMeet and decide_past_stab each exist twice under different namespaces (Probe733Mirror in backward-dual-mirror-fixture.lean, Probe719Backward in backward-dual-asymmetric-fixture.lean), because probes re-declare rather than import. A bare-name citation is ambiguous between two fixtures. Three task descriptions on this front cite these names unqualified.

Mid-dispatch peer-session relays arrived with ~30 file:line claims. Independent re-verification confirmed nearly all and caught three that would have entered the report wrong: anchorCells_ncard_le is at AnchorLayer.lean:324 not :325; the C9 register is MintBound/Register.lean:9 not MintBound.lean (zero C9 hits there); and the one-line-term property belongs to stabSaturated_univ, not to stabSaturated_of_sameState (four-tactic body). Re-verifying rather than inheriting also upgraded the sorry census from a textual grep to a compiler result via lean-sorry-census.sh --cross-check plus two lean_verify axiom checks.

Obligation (iii) kTypeOf_listSeg_replicate_eventually_periodic closes by pigeonhole in a 15-line scratch proof (scratchpad replicate_periodic_probe.lean), compiled with lake env lean in 2.3s against the current oleans, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. A strengthened shape with the threshold bounded by Nat.card (KType sig k) compiles the same way. Not landed; feasibility only. Re-costs R1's phase 1 from 'may not close' to hours.

RaySummary/README.md:283-284 and hit-presented-model-a.lean:88-100 call (iii) 'the single missing obligation' for (C)'s bound. It is not sufficient: hitCl_eq_truncated's L bounds jump offsets over familyTriples, each an existential over SegmentFactorization cutting sequences (Family.lean:70-95, :201-203), and no lemma in the tree transports a factorization across a lengthened replicated block. The composition step is the unmeasured cost, and (C)'s row also names a general every-model statement that (iii)+L on model A does not touch.

CI runs check-evidence-probes.sh (ci.yml:119-125, continue-on-error) and its summary step exits 1 on any failed check (ci.yml:352-356). The two WIRED_REPO entries for 706/710 point at files git does not track (deleted from the index by archive commit 70321e938, re-pointed to specs/archive/ by e8cfcd868), so a fresh checkout hits check_probe's missing-file branch (:717-720). The 476 entry is force-tracked (ci.yml:239-240 precedent); the other two are not.

Round 1's D4 reads (W) obligation (ii) as 'a hypothesis, not a deliverable'. Read against README.md:378-383, w-soundness-shape-refuted.lean:44-49 and 747 report line 106, (ii) is two proof obligations of the run-layer record: a Hit-level realization theorem for the constructor of (i) (the analogue of presented_modelOf) and the per-cell extraction for every model, which is (C)'s general statement. Filing count unchanged (both belong in R2) but R2's record must carry them.

literature-search.sh --toc on the GKWZ 2003 source returns a flat list of 760 untitled chunks (section_path all 'Gabbay Kurucz Wolter...'); no section navigation. Worked around by deriving a chunk-to-printed-page map from bare page-number lines in each chunk (page p sits in chunk ~p+4 to p+20, drifting), then reading theorem bands by page. BdRV 7.5 (sub-index entry blackburn_2002_ch07_sec05) is not present as a distinct chunk file under sources/blackburn_2002/ and could not be read.

GKWZ 2003 index pages (chunks 748-758) carry printed page numbers for every key notion (product frame p.124, commutativity/Church-Rosser p.220, synchronous system p.136, monodic fragment p.463), which made the by-page theorem lookup cheap: Theorems 5.30, 5.32, 5.38-5.40, 6.60, 6.61, 7.5, 7.17-7.25, 8.22, 11.1, 11.76, 13.3, 13.5, 13.6, 13.10-13.12 and Question 6.62 all located and read at source in one pass.
